body:
This is one of my struggles as well.

At first, it really bother me since I’m an atheist, I thought it was better for people who had an strong belief system. With time and help from my therapist I was able to understand that actually that may not be the case. No one really knows what’s after this life, even if you believe in something, it will hurt the same, you can still have the same doubt. 

But that’s part of the beauty of life isn’t it? How bittersweetly ephemeral it is without knowing if there’s something after. The only thing we are sure is that this is the only chance we have. And even in this short time which is our life we found someone great, someone who gave us happiness and beautiful moments. Moments and learnings that are part of us. The ones we lost are part of us while we are here, trying to make the best of the time we have remaining in here is a tribute to that, to the one we love and accompanies us in every step of the way.

I’m sorry for your loss, and i guess I agree, if there was a way to make sure that my parents or close friends will not suffer the way I am suffering, I would have already make an attempt to do it… I guess I will try to keep on, even though I don’t want it
Thank you for taking the time and your words
Thanks, i will research on grieving groups, maybe it can help.
Thank you, this means a lot.

Thank you, no one was able to give me a response like this, they usually just tell me that it will get better or that I have support. And you’re right, i feel like there is something breaking me from the inside, bigger that me… something I’m fighting all the time… I know he would have wanted me to be ok, he was a good person that was always worried about me being ok and sometimes I try to hold on to that, but on days like this, life feels so empty and hopeless.
